name: Starfall
author: Sweepercom
description: A gacha game's wish screen under a night sky. A featured banner, three more screens behind tabs, and Wish buttons that play a falling star and reveal one of your characters. Your character list becomes an archive of foil cards.

components.name: Night sky
components.blurb: The backdrop behind everything: drifting clouds of colour, three sheets of blinking stars, a shooting star now and then and a glow on the horizon.

components.name: Opening curtain
components.blurb: Two seconds over the page as it loads: a gold star turns once, rings spread from it and the word settles.

components.name: Stage & player card
components.blurb: The glass stage with its gilt frame and the tabs across the top. Your avatar in a turning ring, your name, badges, followers as the currency counter and Follow as the gold button. Includes its phone layout.

components.name: Event banner & Wish buttons
components.blurb: The first screen: a title, a few lines, the featured names and a floating gilt frame for a picture. Under it, Wish ×1 and Wish ×10.

components.name: Wish animation & results
components.blurb: What a Wish button opens: the screen darkens, a star falls, light bursts, and a character is revealed with five stars and a Chat now button. Wish ×10 deals a spread of ten cards.

components.name: Traveler screen
components.blurb: Behind the Traveler tab: an About card with a signature line, three stat tiles and your links as waypoints.

components.name: Details screen
components.blurb: Behind the Details tab: the fine print as lines that open on a click. Requests, reposting, feedback.

components.name: Party screen
components.blurb: Behind the Party tab: other creators lined up like party members, each with a ringed portrait and a line about them.

components.name: Character Archive
components.blurb: Your real character list as foil cards: the picture edge to edge in a gilt frame, five stars and the name on a plate, the chat count in the corner, and tags that slide up when the card is pointed at. Also the tabs, the filter bar and the page buttons.

components.name: Site header
components.blurb: JanitorAI's top bar, search, menus and phone navigation in midnight blue and gold.

components.name: Template credit
components.blurb: A small credit line at the foot of the stage.

notes: The avatar, username, follower count, badges, Follow button and character list are JanitorAI's own elements, restyled.
Screens and wishes are CSS only (:target and :has). One thing is open at a time.
Wish ×1 is not random: its links take turns quickly, so the result depends on when it is clicked.
An original design in the style of gacha games; not affiliated with any of them.
